+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboPaint trajectory for the supplied lettering exemplar.
+
+The same helpers are used for practice-sheet calibration and the final 14 main
+sheet strokes.  Coordinates passed to the client are pen-tip world poses.
+"""
+import json, math, os, sys
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/runs"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+
+def qmul(a, b):
+    aw, ax, ay, az = a; bw, bx, by, bz = b
+    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
+                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
+                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
+                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw], dtype=float)
+
+def down_quat(theta=0.0):
+    # Initial downward tool orientation, rotated around world vertical.
+    return qmul([math.cos(theta/2), 0, 0, math.sin(theta/2)], [0, 1, 0, 0])
+
+def slerp(a, b, t):
+    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float); b=np.asarray(b,dtype=float)
+    dot=float(np.dot(a,b))
+    if dot < 0: b=-b; dot=-dot
+    dot=min(1.0,max(-1.0,dot))
+    if dot > .9995:
+        q=a+t*(b-a); return q/np.linalg.norm(q)
+    ang=math.acos(dot); den=math.sin(ang)
+    return (math.sin((1-t)*ang)*a + math.sin(t*ang)*b)/den
+
+def paper_world(u, v):
+    """Exemplar pixel centre -> main-sheet world XY."""
+    mmpp=0.227185/1024*1000
+    X=(u+.5)*mmpp; Y=(v+.5)*mmpp
+    return (-.1+.227185/2-Y/1000, .227185/2-X/1000)
+
+def move(robot, start, end, note, cameras=("canvas_cam","side_cam","scene_cam"), video="none", settle=4):
+    """Slow Cartesian interpolation; each adjacent target differs by <=2.2 mm."""
+    start=np.asarray(start,dtype=float); end=np.asarray(end,dtype=float)
+    dist=float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3]-start[:3]))
+    angle=2*math.acos(min(1.0,abs(float(np.dot(start[3:],end[3:])))))
+    n=max(1, int(math.ceil(max(dist/.0022, angle/math.radians(2.5)))))
+    rows=[]
+    for k in range(1,n+1):
+        t=k/n
+        p=start[:3]*(1-t)+end[:3]*t
+        q=slerp(start[3:],end[3:],t)
+        rows.append(np.r_[p,q])
+    rows.extend([end.copy() for _ in range(settle)])
+    res=robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32), dt=.05,
+                     cameras=cameras, video=video, video_fps=5, note=note)
+    print(note, "steps",res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"), "plan",res.meta.get("plan"), "time_left",res.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    return end.copy(), res
+
+def paint_line(robot, a, b, q, note, cameras=("practice_cam","side_cam","scene_cam"), video="both"):
+    """One contact, preceded/followed by a 5 mm lift."""
+    global current
+    high_a=np.r_[a[:2], .040, q]
+    contact_a=np.r_[a[:2], .018, q]
+    contact_b=np.r_[b[:2], .018, q]
+    high_b=np.r_[b[:2], .040, q]
+    current,res=move(robot,current,high_a,note+" position",cameras,video="none")
+    current,res=move(robot,current,contact_a,note+" lower",cameras,video="none",settle=3)
+    current,res=move(robot,current,contact_b,note+" draw",cameras,video=video,settle=2)
+    if video != "none": res.save(os.path.join(OUT,"practice_test"))
+    current,res=move(robot,current,high_b,note+" lift",cameras,video="none")
+    return res
+
+def practice():
+    global current
+    r=Robot()
+    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+    obs.save(os.path.join(OUT,"before_practice"))
+    now=np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"],dtype=float)
+    current=np.r_[now[7:10],now[10:14]]
+    print("initial",current,"time_left",obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    theta=math.radians(43)
+    q=down_quat(theta)
+    # Load the pen: tip enters the well and sits 1.5 mm below the ink surface.
+    current,res=move(r,current,np.array([-.100,.150,.070,*q]),"approach ink",video="none")
+    current,res=move(r,current,np.array([-.100,.150,.0265,*q]),"dip ink",video="both",
+                     cameras=("practice_cam","side_cam","scene_cam"),settle=8)
+    res.save(os.path.join(OUT,"ink_dip"))
+    current,res=move(r,current,np.array([-.100,.150,.070,*q]),"lift ink",video="none")
+    # Practice vertical stem, moving toward the robot (decreasing world x).
+    current,res=move(r,current,np.array([-.100,-.1856,.060,*q]),"to practice",video="none")
+    paint_line(r,(-.055,-.1856),(-.075,-.1856),q,"practice stem")
+    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+    obs.save(os.path.join(OUT,"after_practice"))
+    print("practice done",obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10])
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "practice"
+    if mode=="practice": practice()
*** End Patch";

+def contact_path(robot, start, points, q, note, video="none", cameras=("canvas_cam","side_cam","scene_cam")):
+    """Follow one continuous ink contact through a polyline, then lift."""
+    global current
+    p0=np.r_[points[0],.040,q]
+    current,res=move(robot,current,p0,note+" position",cameras,video="none")
+    pz=np.r_[points[0],.018,q]
+    current,res=move(robot,current,pz,note+" lower",cameras,video="none",settle=3)
+    rows=[]
+    prev=np.asarray(points[0],dtype=float)
+    for dest in points[1:]:
+        dest=np.asarray(dest,dtype=float)
+        n=max(1,int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(dest-prev)/.0015)))
+        for k in range(1,n+1):
+            xy=prev+(dest-prev)*(k/n)
+            rows.append(np.r_[xy,.018,q])
+        prev=dest
+    rows.extend([np.r_[prev,.018,q] for _ in range(3)])
+    res=robot.submit("ee_pose",np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32),dt=.05,
+                     cameras=cameras,video=video,video_fps=5,note=note+" ink")
+    plan=res.meta.get("plan") or []
+    fails=sum(int(p.get("ik_failures",0)) for p in plan)
+    print(note+" ink","steps",res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),"ik_failures",fails,
+          "time_left",res.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    if video != "none": res.save(os.path.join(OUT,"main_"+note.replace(" ","_")))
+    current=np.r_[prev,.018,q]
+    high=np.r_[prev,.040,q]
+    current,res=move(robot,current,high,note+" lift",cameras,video="none")
+    return res
+
+def stem_pixels(u):
+    return [paper_world(uu,vv) for uu,vv in stem_path(u)]
+
+def draw_stem(robot,u,tag,video="none"):
+    q=down_quat(math.radians(30))
+    return contact_path(robot,stem_pixels(u),stem_pixels(u),q,tag,video=video)

+def dot_pixels(center_u,center_v,length_mm=2.4):
+    # The target dots are short strokes perpendicular to the 30 degree nib edge.
+    halfpx=(length_mm/2)/(0.227185/1024*1000)
